title: The molecular cartography of malignant and benign sebaceous tumours
core_idea: Assemble an extensive worldwide collection of sebaceous tumours (benign and malignant) and perform deep molecular characterisation to map their genomic landscape and interrogate the mutational processes and recurrent genomic alterations that distinguish tumour types.
tldr: A global cohort of 286 sebaceous tumours is deeply characterised to map molecular features and investigate mutational processes and genomic alterations across benign and malignant lesions.
